title: AGM Transfer Bundle Manifest
description: Per-bundle manifest stored at the root of every AGM transfer .tar archive.

created.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which the bundle was generated

generator.description: Identifier of the tool that produced the bundle (e.g., agm-bundle.sh/0.1.0)

name.description: Filename relative to the bundle root

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the file contents
